Problem: Sourceforge.

If it hasn't been apparent, Sourceforge has been taking control of "inactive" or "abandoned" projects, such as GIMP, VLC Media Player, and Nmap, and started wrapping those in their own installer, along with adware prompts. Now, some of the PC Master Race may not be members of the IT community, but this shit hit the fan a month ago.

Sourceforge has since stopped meddling with the existing installers (meaning no more adware unless previously authorized), but that particular set of bad moves has caused the /v/sysadmin (and the other /sysadmin board) to call a stop for visiting the site. The adblocking plugin uBlock Origin also added an update to its list to warn you for going to Sourceforge on account of the adware.
